away.summary: The Oilers (3-0-1) are dealing with several key injuries, including Andersen, Hyman, Janmark, Nugent-Hopkins, Regula, Savoie, and Dach. Jason Dickinson has been activated off IR and is expected to make his season debut, while Filip Hallander, recently acquired from Pittsburgh, could make his Oilers debut after skating in practice. The team is working to regain depth as they prepare for the Sharks matchup.

home.summary: The Sharks (3-1-0) are missing Macklin Celebrini (lower-body injury, game-time decision) and Adam Gaudette (upper-body injury, but could return after full practice). Kiefer Sherwood is also a game-time decision due to an upper-body injury. Yaroslav Askarov is projected to start in goal, with Alex Nedeljkovic as the backup. The team is managing several key availability questions heading into the game.
